segments.name: Costa Rica
segments.description: Leases warehouses in Costa Rica to commercial tenants, the company's largest operating segment.
segments.evidence: As of December 31, 2025, Costa Rica is our largest operating segment, with 19 buildings and an Operating GLA of 2.5 million square feet.

segments.name: Colombia
segments.description: Leases warehouses in Colombia to commercial tenants under operating leases.
segments.evidence: As of December 31, 2025, Colombia has 5 buildings with an Operating GLA of 1.3 million square feet and land reserves of 50.6 acres.

segments.name: Peru
segments.description: Leases warehouses in Peru to commercial tenants under operating leases.
segments.evidence: As of December 31, 2025, Peru has 8 buildings with an Operating GLA of 1.8 million square feet and land reserves of 19.0 acres.

segments.name: Mexico
segments.description: Leases warehouses in Puebla, Mexico, a segment added in 2025 to commercial tenants.
segments.evidence: As of December 31, 2025, Mexico has 2 buildings with an Operating GLA of 0.3 million square feet.

revenueModel.text: Tenants pay rent under operating leases for warehouse space in Costa Rica, Colombia, Peru and Mexico.
revenueModel.evidence: The four geographic segments primarily derive revenue from various operating leases with customers for the rental of warehouses.

changes.text: Mexico was added as a fourth operating segment beginning in the third quarter of 2025.
changes.evidence: The Mexico operating segment was added as our fourth segment beginning in the third quarter of 2025.
